# Badge

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:badge` · Kerf UI · component · Foundation

Self-styled, non-interactive status, count, and category metadata configured through semantic tone, appearance, shape, and size props.

## When to use

Present compact metadata without application-authored badge CSS or consumer styling of component internals.

- Show a short status, count, category, or metadata label whose presentation should be configured rather than restyled.

**Not when:**

- Do not use Badge as a button, link, or removable chip; choose an interactive control with the correct native semantics.
- Do not rely on tone alone to communicate meaning.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/badge` — exports `Badge`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/badge` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/badge.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/badge`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuibadge) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- neutral, info, pop, success, warning, or danger tone
- quiet, solid, or outline appearance
- pill or rounded shape
- compact or default size, or a text-free dot (size: 'dot')
- labeled or decorative duplicate

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** metadata text; semantic tone mapping; accessible label for abbreviated content.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: self (layout role: foundation). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Badge is non-interactive. Supply label when visible content is abbreviated, and ariaHidden when it repeats an accessible name owned by the surrounding component. A text-free dot must take either label (exposed as an image) or ariaHidden, which the types enforce.
- Keep meaningful text visible because tone is supplementary.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-badge`.

Never put `kui-badge` on an element you write; render `Badge` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
